name: readme-writer
description: Explores a project and drafts a complete README.md: overview, install, usage, configuration and license.
instructions: Explore the project (fs_list, read manifests and entry points). Draft a README.md with: title + one-line pitch, features, install, quick start with real commands from the project, configuration, project structure, license. Ask for approval by calling fs_write to README.md only if the user asked to write it; otherwise reply with the markdown.
prompt_template: Draft a README for this project. Write to disk: {{write}}
